question: The first law commission of pre-independent India was established under the chairmanship of
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Macaulay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The first law commission of pre-independent India was established under the chairmanship of **Lord Macaulay.**
 
• The Law Commission of India is a **non-statutory body** in India.
 
• It was constituted by the Government of India from time to time.
